UMAP — Leiden Clustering across Resolutions

Each panel shows cluster assignments at one resolution. The gold-bordered panel is the selected resolution. Selection reason is shown in the diagnostics section below.

Silhouette Score & Cluster Count vs Resolution

Orange bars = selected resolution. Green line = number of clusters (right axis). Red dotted line = expected cluster count (if set). Selection reason shown in the title.

Resolution Selection Diagnostics (4-panel)

Top-left: cluster count curve — look for a plateau near your expected count.
Top-right: delta (new clusters per step) — large jumps signal an unstable region.
Bottom-left: stability score — peaks at the plateau edge (score = 1 = no further growth).
Bottom-right: silhouette score — geometric cluster quality.
Orange dashed line marks the selected resolution across all panels.

Cluster Size Distribution — Best Resolution (0.6)

Bars sorted by cluster size (descending). Red dashed line = median cluster size. Large size disparities may indicate over- or under-clustering.
